description: This file defines an abstract base class for image toolkit plugins in Drupal, including methods for setting/getting image source, applying operations, and managing dependencies.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\ImageToolkit\ImageToolkitBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for image toolkit plugins, providing common functionality and interface implementations.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the image source path; can only be called once.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the current image source path.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Returns an array of requirements; default is empty.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a specified image operation using the appropriate plugin, with error handling.
